packages.title: Packages
packages.versions_hint: The active version is stored in the profile (Menu > Profile). When it changes, the affected services are stopped with the old settings and started with the new version.
prefs.app_update_check: Check for new KaradelikDev versions (GitHub, daily)
prefs.auto_vhosts_hint: Put a folder in www; it is added to the hosts file and Apache/Nginx automatically.
prefs.data_dir_hint: To use Laragon's databases, pick Laragon's data folder (do not run both at the same time).
prefs.data_dir_hint.mac: Per-version database folders are created here (e.g. mysql-8.4).
prefs.editor.mac: Editor (empty = VS Code / default text editor)
prefs.lan_access: Allow access from the local network (Apache, Nginx)
prefs.lan_access_hint: When off, the web servers are reachable only from this computer. Turn on to test from a phone; anyone on the same network can then reach your projects. Admin panels (phpMyAdmin...) always open only from localhost.
prefs.lan_access_hint.mac: When off, web servers are reachable only from this Mac (macOS only allows ports 80/443 on all interfaces, so access is restricted inside the server). Turn on to test from a phone; anyone on the same network can reach your projects.
prefs.manage_hosts: Manage the hosts file (asks for admin permission)
prefs.manage_hosts.mac: Manage hosts file (asks for the admin password)
prefs.manage_hosts_hint: When off, the hosts file is untouched. The {name}.localhost format works in browsers without hosts.
prefs.restart_note: Running services are restarted on save if their settings changed.
projects.hint: PHP version: when a version other than the profile's is chosen, the project runs on that version's php-cgi (Apache and Nginx). Proxy port: start your dev server yourself (e.g. npm run dev or a Procfile entry); http://project.test is forwarded to it. Vite needs no server.hmr setting.
projects.invalid: Folders with invalid names were skipped (no spaces or _): {0}
projects.proxy_hint: Port of a dev server such as Vite, Next.js or Node (e.g. 5173). When set, the project address is proxied to it (WebSocket/HMR included); when empty, it is served with PHP.
projects.title: Projects

If you used portable KaradelikDev before, pick that folder; your projects and databases are used as they are. The app restarts after a change.
